question: Cricket became an international game with the formation of the Imperial Cricket Conference (ICC) in the year _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1909**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Imperial Cricket Conference** (ICC) was **formed** in **1909**, propelling cricket into the **global arena**.
 
• The** ICC **later evolved into the** International Cricket Council** (ICC) in **1965**.
 
• The formation of the ICC marked the beginning of** international cricket governance and coordination**.
 
• The ICC organizes major** tournaments **and **maintains a standardized approach **to the game globally.
 
• Its establishment marked a milestone, recognizing **cricket's international** appeal and the necessity for a **governing body**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI):**

 
 
• **BCCI **was **established in 1928** as the governing body for cricket in **India**.
 
• It regulates and promotes cricket in India at both **national and international levels**.
 
• BCCI is a **society registered** under the **Tamil Nadu Societies Registration Act**.
 
• BCCI manages **domestic cricket tournaments** like the **Ranji Trophy** and the **Indian Premier League** (IPL).
